title: SETTINGS PANE SKIPS ROWS UNDER THE TAB STRIP
why: Critic c-31 (Settings 72, P0): after the Display chip the pane still named Vibration strength, a Controller row hidden under the sticky tab strip.
now: Settings detail names the first row below the tab strip.

edits.anchor: function vis(x){ var a=sl.getBoundingClientRect(), c=x.getBoundingClientRect(), m=(c.top+c.bottom)/2; return !a.height||(m>=a.top&&m<=a.bottom); }
edits.replacement: function vis(x){ var a=sl.getBoundingClientRect(), c=x.getBoundingClientRect(), m=(c.top+c.bottom)/2, bar=sl.querySelector('.setjump'), t=a.top+(bar?bar.getBoundingClientRect().height:0); return !a.height||(m>=t&&m<=a.bottom); }   // v28.xx (cw-setvis2) the sticky tab strip covers the top of the list: a row under it is not in view (after the Display tab the pane named the Controller row above it)
